title: Paṭhamabrahmacariyasuttaṃ
text: 39 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. ‘‘Brahmacariyañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, brahmacariyaphalāni ca. Taṃ suṇātha. Katamañca, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ? Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi…pe… sammāsamādhi. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ. Katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalāni? Sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ – imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalānī’’ti. Navamaṃ.
